ns2:course.label: Relationships in Acting I
ns2:course.description: Behavior in stage performance explored on the basis of the actor's relationship with self, with objects, and with other players; emphasizes analysis of playscript to discover action, environment, and relationships. Prerequisite: THEA 175 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: THEA 175 or consent of instructor.
